name: Jinglv Environment Science and Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Established in 2002 and headquartered in Hefei, China, Jinglv Environment Science and Technology Co., Ltd. operates in the environmental sanitation sector, both producing and selling specialized equipment. The company's diverse service portfolio includes comprehensive cleaning operations, the collection, sorting, and transfer of household waste, as well as the management and refurbishment of public restrooms. Additionally, Jinglv provides solutions for agricultural environmental challenges, such as village sewage treatment. Through a franchising model, they offer sanitation investment and operational management services, notably including ongoing toilet care and maintenance. Their product offerings feature a range of sanitation vehicles, waste compression machinery, rural wastewater treatment systems, underground refuse containers, and various toilet-related products.
